text:
Maria G: Quick sync — prelaunch SEO + redirect checklist for the webinar landing. Need owners & ETAs by EOD. TL;DR: keywords, JSON-LD, internal links, redirect sweep, canonical tags, GTM/UTM mapping.

Alex H: I can own keywords + headings. Will post a keyword map in Drive by 3pm (intent + volume + target URL).

Samir (growth): I’ll do the schema JSON-LD for the landing (webinarEvent + speaker info). Need final date/time and speaker display names.

Maria G: Date is Tue May 14 11:00 PT. Speakers: Priya K, Dan L. Use timezone-neutral ISO in LD. @Samir include startDate/endDate and `duration`.

Riya: I’ll run an internal-link pass across blog + docs to push authority to the landing. Will produce top-10 pillar pages and anchor text suggestions.

Alex H: Keyword map notes: primary = "webinar launch playbook", secondary = "benchmark narratives for startups", add longtails. I’ll include canonical target for each keyword.

seo-bot: Scheduled a full site crawl at 1728510200. Will flag 3xx/4xx, missing canonicals, and redirect chains. Use `/crawl status` in #eng-infra to follow.

Maria G: Redirect sweep: convert legacy `/webinar-old` -> `/webinar-launch` (301). Add a rewrite rule example for infra: 

```
# nginx example
rewrite ^/webinar-old(.*)$ /webinar-launch$1 permanent;
```

Samir (growth): Also include `WebSite` + `Event` markup and add CTA action in LD so Google can pick up the registration CTA. Draft snippet (edit before merge):

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Webinar: Launch Playbook",
  "startDate": "2024-05-14T18:00:00Z",
  "endDate": "2024-05-14T19:00:00Z",
  "location": {"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.inference/webinar-launch"},
  "performer": [{"@type":"Person","name":"Priya K","sameAs":"https://linkedin.com/in/priyak"}],
  "offers": {"@type":"Offer","url":"https://redwood.inference/webinar-launch/register","availability":"https://schema.org/InStock"}
}
```

Riya: I’ll QA redirects post-deploy. Can someone create a canary/staging preview URL? @eng-frontend or @devops please.

Alex H: Adding redirects + canonical tags to a PR now. ETA 5pm. Will tag eng-frontend for preview.

Maria G: Perf & meta notes: keep hero H1 matching primary keyword, add `og:title`, `og:description`, and `twitter:card` meta. Ensure meta description includes registration CTA and date.

Samir (growth): One more — add `sameAs` array for speaker profiles in LD and link to canonical speaker pages.

Riya: I’ll run an anchor-text audit and return a CSV with suggested anchor swaps (prioritize exact/partial matches to primary keywords).

Alex H: Keyword map uploaded: https://drive.internal/redwood/kw-map-webinar (check folder).

Maria G: Plan if no blockers: PRs today -> staging smoke tomorrow AM -> deploy Wed morning. Thanks everyone. :rocket:

Alex H: :thumbsup:

Samir (growth): Leaving a short TODO in the draft PR to remind to bump schema `startDate` to final timezone string if speakers change.

Riya: Will post QA checklist after staging link is up.

Maria G: Great — tagging this thread as the single source for launch SEO ops. Ping here with blockers.
